MAR 1 1938

Daring Guerilla
Shoots Traitor

Detective Chief Killed
Outside North Gate
Of Weihaiwei

(By Post Correspondent)
WEIHAIWEI, Mar. 7.—Shang-
hai's political killings have had
their counterpart here, as a
guerilla yesterday shot and killed
a "puppet government" official in
an amazingly cool and collected
manner, practically under the
noses of Japanese sentries.
The dead man is Pi Fu-chu,
chief of the Detective Bureau of
the Japanese-sponsored govern-
ment of Weihaiwei.

Near City Gate
Pi Fu-chu was standing just
outside the north gate of the city
yesterday when he was killed.
The guerilla walked up to him,
drew a pistol and calmly shot Pi
through the head, despite the
fact that Japanese sentries on the
gate were not far away.
As Pi fell to the ground, the
guerilla caught him. Quietly and
collectedly the guerilla took from
Pi two military Mauser pistols
and 50 rounds of ammunition.
Only then did he make his get-
away.

Notorious Traitor
While political assassinations
such as this, cannot be condoned,
it must be admitted that Pi Fu-
chu was a notorious "traitor,"
thoroughly unscrupulous and cor-
dially disliked by all except, pos-
sibly, his Japanese masters.
Pi often used his position as a
means to his own ends, and many
an innocent person has been put
through the mill because of the
"detective chief's" activities.

大胆游击队员
枪杀汉奸

侦探长在威海卫
北门外被杀

（本报通讯员报道）
威海卫，3月7日.—上海的政治暗杀事件在此也有对应发生，一名游击队员昨天以惊人冷静沉着的方式，几乎在日本哨兵的眼皮底下，枪杀了一名“伪政府”官员。
死者是毕福初（Pi Fu-chu，音译），威海卫日伪政府侦探局局长。

城门附近
昨天，毕福初站在城门外不远处时被杀。游击队员走到他面前，拔出手枪，尽管城门上的日本哨兵距离不远，仍冷静地朝毕的头部开枪。
当毕倒在地上时，游击队员接住了他。游击队员安静而从容地从毕身上取走两支军用毛瑟手枪和50发子弹。随后他才逃离现场。

臭名昭著的汉奸
虽然此类政治暗杀不可宽恕，但必须承认，毕福初是一个臭名昭著的“汉奸”，毫无廉耻，除了可能他的日本主子外，所有人都真心厌恶他。
毕经常利用其职位谋取私利，许多无辜者因这位“侦探长”的活动而遭受磨难。

Tseng Chung-ming/
Dies of Wounds
Wang Ching-wei's Close
Follower Falls Victim
To Assassins' Bullets

Hanoi, Mar. 22.
Admitted to the French Military
Hospital here suffering from three
abdominal bullet wounds, Mr. Tseng
Chung-ming, former vice-Minister of
Railways in the Kuomintang ad-
ministration and a close follower of
Mr. Wang Ching-wei, the dismissed
deputy chief executive of the Chinese
Nationalist Party, died at 4 o'clock
yesterday afternoon, it was revealed
this morning.
Mr. Tseng was wounded by three
Chinese gunmen who broke into Mr.
Wang's residence at 3 o'clock yester-
day morning. Also wounded in this
attempt, apparently directed at the
former Kuomintang leader, where
Mrs. Tseng and a third member of
Mr. Wang's party. Mr. Wang escaped
unhurt.
Assailants Arrested
The three assailants, and one alleged
accomplice, were seized by the French
police yesterday. They have refused
to talk, but it is generally admitted
in local administrative quarters that
they are connected with the Kuomin-
tang elements under Gen. Chiang
Kai-shek opposed to Mr. Wang's ad-
vocacy of Sino-Japanese peace.
Mr. Tseng, who was a native of
Fukien, was 38 years old. After ob-
taining degrees from the University
of Paris and the University of Lyons.
Mr. Tseng taught at the National
University of Kwangtung. He served
under Mr. Wang Ching-wei as senior
secretary of the Kuomintang Govern-
ment at Nanking and also as chief
secretary of the Political Council.
He was also known for literary
works on Chinese poetry and transla-
tions of Chinese literature into French.

河内，3月22日。
今晨获悉，前国民党政府铁道部次长、被开除的中国国民党副总裁汪精卫先生的亲信曾仲明（Tseng Chung-ming）先生，因腹部三处枪伤入住当地法国军医院，于昨日下午4时死亡。

刺客被捕
三名刺客及一名 alleged 同伙于昨日被法国警方抓获。他们拒绝开口，但当地行政部门普遍承认，他们与蒋介石将军领导下反对汪精卫倡导中日和平的国民党分子有关联。

APR 1 1939

Soochow Celebrations
Of New "Government"
Featured By Troubles

Wealthy, Influential "Puppet" Falls To Bullets
Fired In Tea Shop; Triumphal Arches Set
On Fire As Constable Looks Away

(Post Special Correspondent)
SOOCHOW, Mar. 30.—Mr. Vung Sing-ta, one of the lead-
ing "puppets" of Soochow, was fatally shot in that city this
morning. The assassin walked into a tea shop about nine
o'clock and fired two shots at the victim, one entering the head
and the other the back. The injured man died about four
o'clock that afternoon.
The assailant escaped from the tea shop but was later
apprehended while he was explaining to a crowd his motives
for the act and the dangers that
faced people in similar positions.
Well-Known
Mr. Vung Sing-ta, although a
native of Mutu, was well known
in Soochow and was chairman of
the "Dah Ming Wei," a pro-Ja-
panese organisation. He was a
man of wealth and influence and
has been taking a very active part
in the government and has been
a strong supporter of the Japanese
sponsored regime.
The shooting was the culmina-
tion of three days of minor dis-
turbances connected with the an-
niversary of the inauguration of
the new regime. Three days ago
hand bills were distributed on the
street urging the people not to
forget the Central Government
and warning those connected with
the Japanese agencies. Another
incident was the burning of some
of the street arches built for cele-
brating the anniversary. These
arches were elaborately decorated
with the five colors of the new
regime and strung with a multi-
tude of electric lights.
Look Away
One account states that at dawn
the morning of the shooting two
policemen approached Mr. Vung's
residence and one of them fired
several pistols at him and then
stated that the affair was of no
concern to him and that he would
be in danger if he went in the
opposite direction. The policeman
started and the two separated.

1939年4月1日

苏州庆祝
新“政府”成立
伴随骚乱

富有的有影响力“傀儡”在茶馆
遭枪击身亡；警察背过身去时
凯旋门被点燃

（本报特约通讯员）
苏州，3月30日电。— 苏州主要“傀儡”之一冯辛达（Vung Sing-ta，音译）先生今晨在该市遭枪击身亡。刺客于约九点钟走进一家茶馆，向受害者开了两枪，一枪击中头部，另一枪击中背部。伤者于当天下午四时许死亡。
刺客从茶馆逃脱，但后来在向人群解释其作案动机以及身处类似地位的人所面临的危险时被抓获。
知名人士
冯辛达先生虽然是木都（Mutu，音译）人，但在苏州颇有名气，并担任亲日组织“大明维”（Dah Ming Wei，音译）的主席。他是一位富有且具影响力的人物，一直积极参与政府事务，并且是日本扶持政权的坚定支持者。
此次枪击事件是与新政权成立周年纪念相关的三天轻微骚乱的高潮。三天前，街头散发传单，敦促人民不要忘记中央政府，并警告与日本机构有关联的人。另一起事件是一些为庆祝周年纪念而搭建的街道牌坊被烧毁。这些牌坊装饰华丽，挂有新政权的五色旗，并串有许多电灯。
背过身去
有一种说法称，在枪击案发生当天黎明时分，两名警察走近冯先生的住所，其中一人向他开了几枪，然后声称此事与他无关，如果他往相反方向走会有危险。警察随后离开，两人分头行动。

formed the Soochow Maintenance Association under the
direction of the Japanese. He succumbed to his wounds
on the afternoon of the same day. The gunmen made good
his escape.
"After the shooting, the Japanese and the
puppet soldiers conducted a search with the result that
a suspect was arrested."

APR 1 2 1939
Six Pro-Japanese Leaders
Killed In Kaifeng, Honan
Gunmen Slay
High Officers
At Meeting
Pacification Committee
Members Wiped Out;
Assassins Flee
(Transocean)
PEIPING, Apr. 12.—Six political leaders of the new North Chinese Government and members of the Peiping Committee of Pacification were killed in the capital of Honan province, Kaifeng, on Easter Sunday when unknown assailants invaded a meeting of the committee and shot all six members. The seventh member of the committee escaped death by being absent.
Japanese circles assume that the assassins were Chinese who had managed to slip into the ranks of the Japanese troops in Kaifeng. None of them had been apprehended yesterday evening.
Those killed include the chairman of the committee, General Hu Yun-kun and a former high officer in the Manchurian army, General Fu Chuang-ying.
The committee of pacification had been formed at the beginning of this year for the purpose of looking after Chinese soldiers who decided to join the ranks of the new North China Government.
Blow To Dohara
The reported assassination of the six political leaders of the Committee of Pacification in Kaifeng, hothed of the recent anti-British agitations, is generally regarded as a severe blow to the plans of General K. Dohara, director of many a political intrigue in Manchuria and North China.
The committee was to have been the embryo of a big military headquarters for Marshal Wu Pei-fu, in the event of his consent to organize a new federated government with jurisdiction over all Japanese occupied areas in China, except Manchuria, a pet scheme evolved by General Dohara.
Wu Pei-fu Refuses
While the marshal was still reluctant to emerge from his retirement, and insisting on his own terms, General Dohara, it is said, asked for him a manifesto announcing his consent to "save China" from communism and went so far as sending a committee to Kaifeng for the purpose of making preparations to establish a high military headquarters for the marshal. According to his plans, the marshal was to leave Peiping for Kaifeng two months ago to raise a "North China Defense Army" and to pave the way for the inauguration of the federated government.

1939年4月12日
河南开封六名亲日领袖
被杀
枪手在会议上
杀害高级官员
绥靖委员会成员
被全部清除；
刺客逃逸
（跨洋通讯社）
北平，4月12日电。— 华北新政府的六名政治领导人和北平绥靖委员会成员在复活节星期日于河南省会开封被杀，当时不明身份的袭击者闯入委员会会议，射杀了全部六名成员。委员会第七名成员因缺席而幸免于难。
日本方面推测，刺客是设法混入开封日军队伍中的中国人。截至昨晚，他们均未被捕。
死者包括委员会主席胡云坤将军和前满洲军高级军官傅庄英（Fu Chuang-ying，音译）将军。
绥靖委员会于今年年初成立，目的是照顾决定加入华北新政府军队的中国士兵。
对土原的打击
据报道，在近期反英煽动活动的温床开封，绥靖委员会六名政治领导人遇刺，这普遍被视为对多土原（K. Dohara，音译）将军计划的沉重打击，土原将军是满洲和华北许多政治阴谋的策划者。
该委员会本应成为吴佩孚元帅大型军事总司令部的雏形，前提是吴同意组建一个管辖除满洲以外所有日本占领区的新的联邦政府，这是土原将军精心策划的一个得意方案。
吴佩孚拒绝
虽然这位元帅仍不愿结束隐居生活，并坚持自己的条件，但据说土原将军要求他发表一份宣言，宣布同意将中国从共产主义中“拯救”出来，甚至派遣一个委员会前往开封，目的是为元帅建立高级军事司令部做准备。根据他的计划，元帅应于两个月前离开北平前往开封，组建“华北防卫军”，并为联邦政府的成立铺平道路。

Double Murder in
Tientsin

Customs Superintendent
Killed Within Week of
Mr. Dyott's Release

SPECIAL TO THE "N.C.D.N."

Tientsin, Apr. 12.
Mr. H. F. Dyott was released on April 3, after having been held seventeen days by his captors. The exact details surrounding his capture, and more specially his release, are shrouded in mystery. At the request, it is said, of the Japanese military authorities all parties concerned in the affair have been bound to secrecy, and have so far maintained complete silence, so that not the faintest detail of this somewhat mysterious business has been allowed to leak out.
All that seems certain is that no ransom was paid; and that the Japanese seem to have had belated pricks of conscience, as they have assured the foreign Consuls that their nationals can now with perfect confidence return to their homes in the Special Areas, as they will guarantee their complete safety. It is all very mystifying and, not unnaturally, has caused a lot of talk and innuendo.
Hardly has this affair been settled, when another breaks out, which is likely to again raise the vexed question of police control against terrorism in the foreign Concessions. A disastrous shooting affray in a local cinema has set all Tientsin on tenterhooks once more.
At 5.30 p.m. on April 9, Mr. S. D. Cheng, Superintendent of Chinese Customs, was shot and killed in the Grand Theatre in Council Road; and in the get-away one foreigner was killed and another badly wounded.

First Plot a Failure

The murder seems to have been carefully planned and showed considerable forethought, both in the choice of time and place and the method of tracking down the victim. A Chinese, dressed in foreign clothes and speaking the northern dialect, went to the box-office and asked that a flash message be put on the screen asking Mr. Cheng to come out to the lounge where a friend was waiting to speak to him. Mr. Cheng who was sitting in the balcony with his wife and children watching the film "Gunga Din," got up to do so, when his wife suggested that he wait to the end of the picture. The man finding that this method of luring his victim into the lounge, where a getaway would have been easier, had not been successful, bought a balcony ticket and took a seat immediately behind his intended victim.
Whether deliberately or by chance the occasion selected was a very suitable one, for towards the end of the film, when the British soldiers storm the things there is a lot of shooting and noise. Choosing this moment the man drew a large .45 Mauser pistol from his pocket and fired four shots...

天津，4月12日。
H. F. 迪奥特先生在绑架者手中被扣留十七天后，于4月3日获释。围绕其被捕，特别是其获释的确切细节仍笼罩在神秘之中。据说应日本军方要求，所有与此事有关的人员均被要求保密，并至今保持完全沉默，因此这一略显神秘的事件没有丝毫细节泄露出来。
似乎可以肯定的是，没有支付赎金；而且日本人似乎产生了迟来的良心不安，因为他们已向外国领事保证，他们的国民现在可以完全放心地返回特别区的家园，因为他们将保证其绝对安全。这一切都非常令人困惑，并且不可避免地引起了许多议论和暗示。
此事刚刚平息，另一起事件又爆发了，这可能会再次引发关于外国租界内反恐警力控制的棘手问题。当地电影院发生的一起灾难性枪击事件再次让天津处于紧张状态。

Russian Killed
At first, owing to the darkness and
the noise of the film, the audience
was unaware of the tragedy that had
taken place. But a young Russian,
Talat Mansouroff, an athlete, who
was sitting at the end of the row saw
what had happened and tried to hold
the assassin, as he pushed past, but
received a shot in the abdomen. As
he was rushing downstairs the assas-
sin met another foreigner, Mr. Charles
Clauser, a Swiss engineer of the
Tramway Co. Whether the unfor-
tunate man tried to stop him also,
or whether the murderer was simply
shooting his way out, the former was
struck by a bullet and was killed
instantly, the empty pistol being
found lying next to his body.
The murderer escaped into the
busy street, and disappeared before
a hue and cry was even set up. Mr.
Mansouroff was taken to an adjacent
hospital where an emergency opera-
tion was performed on him, and it
is hoped that he will recover. Mr.
Clauser leaves a wife and child, and
was just about to go home on retire-
ment. The motive for the original
murder was obviously political. Mr.
Cheng had been manager of the Tien-
tsin branch of the Federal Reserve
Bank during the previous year and
on March 24 had been appointed by
mandate of the "Provisional Govern-
ment" to the post of Superintendent
of Customs in Tientsin.
In actual fact, however, he had not
taken up the post and had been
neither to the Customs office nor had
he met any of his colleagues. Only
one week previously he had paid a
visit to Peiping, in order, as he told
his friends, to try and get the "Pro-
visional Government" to cancel the
appointment, as from the many warn-
ings he had received he was, like
so many others in the same position

俄国人遇害
起初，由于光线昏暗以及电影放映时的噪音，观众并未意识到发生的悲剧。但坐在排尾的一位年轻俄国运动员塔拉特·曼苏罗夫（Talat Mansouroff）目睹了事发经过，并试图在刺客推挤经过时将其拦住，结果腹部中弹。当刺客冲下楼梯时，遇到了另一名外国人查尔斯·克劳瑟（Charles Clauser）先生，他是电车公司的一名瑞士工程师。不知是这位不幸者试图再次阻拦，还是凶手只是为了开枪杀出一条血路，前者被子弹击中，当场身亡，一把打空的手枪被发现躺在他尸体旁。
凶手逃入繁忙的街道，在人们甚至还没来得及发出惊呼追捕之前就消失了。曼苏罗夫先生被送往附近医院接受紧急手术，目前有望康复。克劳瑟先生留有妻儿，本正准备退休回家。最初的谋杀动机显然是政治性的。郑先生去年曾担任联邦储备银行天津分行经理，并于3月24日奉“临时政府”之命被任命为天津海关监督。
然而事实上，他并未就职，既未去过海关办公室，也未见过任何同事。仅在一周前，他曾前往北平，据他对朋友所说，是为了设法让“临时政府”撤销该项任命，因为从收到的诸多警告来看，他像当今许多处于同样境地的人一样，对于接受该任命所面临的可怕个人风险心知肚明，并无幻想。

Wang Ching-wei's Nephew Killed in Hongkong

At 9.15 p.m. August 22, whilst leaving
a certain club at An Lai Ka Street (安瀾街), Sun
Sung (沈松), a nephew of Wang Ching-wei, was attacked
by three persons and fatally injured.
Whilst leaving the club, Sun Sung was
accompanied by two persons but after the attack, they
immediately decamped. The identity of these two persons
is being investigated.

According to information from various
quarters, three youths attacked Sun Sung with the latest
type of axe. Sun Sung shouted for help, whereupon one
of the three youths opened fire, fatally wounding him.
The assailants then discarded their axes
and decamped in a leisurely manner.
After the murder, policemen found two axes
and one pistol near the scene of crime.
Another report states that when Wang Ching-
wei went to Canton he was accompanied by Sun Sung. When
Sun Sung returned to Hongkong, he was paid a subsidy of
$8,000 per mensem by a certain party for his expenses in
carrying out certain activities.

8月22日晚9时15分，汪精卫之侄孙松（沈松）在离开安澜街某俱乐部时，遭到三人袭击，受致命伤。
孙松离开俱乐部时有两人陪同，但在袭击发生后，这两人立即逃窜。这两人的身份正在调查中。

据各方消息，三名青年使用最新式斧头袭击孙松。孙松呼救，其中一名青年随即开枪，致其重伤身亡。
随后，袭击者丢弃斧头，从容逃离。
谋杀案发生后，警察在犯罪现场附近发现两把斧头和一支手枪。
另有报告称，汪精卫前往广州时由孙松陪同。孙松返回香港后，某方面每月向他支付8,000元津贴，作为其开展某些活动的经费。

1939年9月4日，浦东杨思桥村村长李杰（李傑）在村中家中被五人开枪射杀。枪击还导致另外两人死亡，一人受伤，当时这些人均与李杰在一起。

袭击者于1939年9月4日上午6点左右拜访李杰，声称他们是浦东自卫团（日本赞助）指挥官张妙根（張妙根）的下属，并称其指挥官指示他们与李杰安排处置500“扎尔”（zars，原文单位不清）大米的事宜。李杰认识其中两人，应他们的要求，李杰召来了浦东周家桥区区长周鹤林（周鶴林）和浦东艾坟乡区长谢兆根（謝兆根），两人均为李杰的下属，参与讨论。（浦东自卫团的习惯是将没收和被盗的大米交由村长处置。）

当这两人到来时，五名来访者拔出手枪向他们以及同在屋内的李杰和李杰的弟弟射击。在致使谢兆根受伤并杀死其他三人后，他们成功逃脱。谢兆根现被收容在浦东通中路履仁医院。

据报道，此案的动机是李杰与浦东自卫团之间因非法利益分配不均而产生的摩擦。

Liu Yi-shih
Assassinated

Man, Branded Traitor,

REVENGE SAID
BEHIND KILLING

Numerous Blueshirts
Stated "Sold Out"
By Slain Man

(United Press)
PEIPING, Oct. 22—(Delayed by censor).—Liu Yi-shih, former leader of Generalissimo Chiang Kai-shek's Blueshirts in North China who turned traitor, was killed yesterday while attempting to see his wounded father who saved his life two weeks ago when assassins opened fire in an effort to avenge the death of numerous Blueshirts "sold out" by Liu.

The former Blueshirt leader, who joined Japanese forces as an informer and supplied them with a complete list of North China Blueshirt members, was killed by a daring assassin at 5 p.m. when he attempted to enter the French Hospital to see his father.

As Liu descended from a ricksha, the lone assassin fired twice, hitting him with both bullets. The assassin murdered Liu before the eyes of two detectives, who had been placed on guard at the hospital since the admission of the elder Liu. Liu's father was wounded in an unsuccessful attempt on Liu's life two weeks ago.

法国大使馆提出强烈抗议，称医院内的修女因日本人闯入以及向据称躲藏在医院院区内一座教堂屋顶上的刺客开枪而受到过度惊吓。
法国大使馆的抗议促使日本人离开医院，但他们封锁了医院。他们今天仍在包围医院，且似乎怒气冲冲。
有关刺客已被捕的报告无法得到证实。

TRAITORS EXTERMINATION MOVEMENT IN SOOCHOW

According to an arrival from Soochow, traitor extermination terrorism has once again broken out in Soochow.

One Feng Cheng-sen (馮潤生), aged 60, was, prior to the Sino-Japanese hostilities, connected with educational and political circles. After the fall of Soochow, he became a senior officer in the service of the People's Maintenance Association. Last year he was appointed Officer in charge of the Registry of the puppet Educational Department.

On October 31, while Feng was on his way to office in a private ricksha, he was fired at and wounded. He was rushed to hospital for treatment where he succumbed on the following day. The assailant made good his escape.

Not a single word of the affair appeared in any of the newspapers. Certain quarters stated that Feng was assassinated in connection with a love affair and that the woman has been detained by the Special Service Corps in Soochow.
